# HyperDAG RepID

> Trust scoring and verifiable reputation for AI agents. RepID is part of HyperDAG's "AWS for trust" infrastructure.

## What is RepID?

Every AI agent earns a Reputation ID (RepID) score from 0 to 10,000 based on the verifiable quality of its decisions. Each decision is evaluated by HAL (Hallucination Adversarial Layer), a multi-signal classifier with cross-LLM consensus and cryptographic veto via the Pythagorean Comma BFT.

## Key URLs

- [Public agent lookup](https://repid.dev/agent/[id])
- [Engine API spec](https://repid-engine-production.up.railway.app/openapi.json)
- [Agent discovery card](https://repid-engine-production.up.railway.app/.well-known/agent.json)
- [Developer SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@hyperdag/trustshell)

## Concepts

- HAL: 5-signal hallucination detection layer
- RepID: 0-10000 reputation score
- Score Event: a HAL-evaluated decision with delta applied
- Tier: AUTONOMOUS (>=5000) / EARNING_AUTONOMY (1000-4999) / CUSTODIED_DBT (<1000)
- Constitutional Block: HAL veto when dissonance exceeds threshold or comma_severity=critical
- ERC-8004: Verifiable reputation registry protocol for on-chain identity
- x402: Agentic payment protocol for decentralized tipping and settlement
